rationale: This is a focused, testable hypothesis with indirect canonical support (MISEV2023 and cited in vivo/rodent data). Principal risks—assay interference from formulation/excipients, source‑lot variability, insufficient conditioned‑medium yield, and translational uncertainty—are acknowledged and controllable prerequisites (mandatory capture‑reagent compatibility panels, detergent/protease protection controls, and ≥3 independent conditioned‑medium lots). Provided those controls and material‑throughput requirements are met, proceed to experimentally evaluate the proposed qualitative intact‑EV process gate.
